test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In September 2021, the Tamil Nadu government declared which day 'Mahakavi' Day to commemorate the death anniversary of India's firebrand poet and freedom fighter Subramania Bharathi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11th September.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Mahakavi Day**

__
 
• To** commemorate the death anniversary of freedom fighter Subramania Bharati.**
 
• **Bharati's innovative contributions to Tamil poetry and prose are considered to have sparked a Renaissance in 20th CE Tamil literature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Subramania Bharathi**

 
• **Poet, freedom fighter and social reformer from Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **He was known as Mahakavi Bharathiyar and the laudatory epithet Mahakavi means a great poet**.
 
• He is considered one of **India's greatest poets.**
 
• He **knew 32 languages including 3 foreign languages.**
 
• In 1921 he died from **injuries he sustained from a temple elephant in Madras.**
 
• Other names are** Bharathi, Subbaiah, Sakthi Dasan, Mahakavi, Mundasu Kavignar, Veera Kavi, Selly Dasan.**
